name: slide-decks
title_zh: 会先拆骨架再动手的 PPT 读写改三合一
tagline_zh: 拿到 .pptx 先摸清母版布局，再往网格上放文字、表格、图表和图片。改完能渲染成图或 PDF 自查。
tagline_en: Inspect a deck's layout, generate slides from template masters, place text/tables/charts/images on a grid, and.
desc_en: Build, read, and revise PowerPoint decks (.pptx) — outline an existing deck, generate slides from a template's layouts with python-pptx, place text, tables, charts, and images on a consistent grid, and render to images or PDF for a visual check. Use when the request names slides, a deck, a presentation, or a .pptx; not for Word, spreadsheets, PDFs, or web pages.
why_zh: 先解析模板骨架再落内容，避免坐标瞎猜；渲染自查让你不反复开 PowerPoint。
why_en: Parses the template skeleton before placing content, so you never guess coordinates; renders to images/PDF for visual check.
limit_zh: 只认 .pptx，Word、Excel、PDF、网页一概不管。渲染成图或 PDF 需要本机有 LibreOffice。
limit_en: Only .pptx; no Word/Excel/PDF/web. Rendering to images/PDF requires local LibreOffice. SmartArt & animations are dropped; static layout only.
title_en: Read, build & revise .pptx decks — skeleton first, then.
